Variable Manager

Owning Palette: CalcExpress Toolkit

VIs to manage VarMan variables.

 

Palette Object Description
VM - Close Context.vi Closes a local variable context.
VM - Open Context.vi Opens a local variable context. The maximum number of opened contexts is 65535.
VM3 - 1D Array of CDB.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of CDB data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - 1D Array of DBL.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of DBL data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - 1D Array of Strings.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of Strings data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - 2D Array of CDB.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of CDB data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - 2D Array of DBL.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of DBL data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - 2D Array of Strings.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of Strings data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Arbitrary Data.vi Manages variables that can have an arbitrary data type, supporting both predefined and user-defined data types. Variable values are represented in the Flattened-To-String format, with the exception of the String data type, which uses the native LabVIEW string representation. For predefined data types, the VI checks the consistency of the data type code and value format, returning an error in the event of a mismatch. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - CDB Scalar.vi Manages variables of the CDB Number data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - DBL Scalar.vi Manages variables of the DBL Number data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - String.vi Manages variables of the String data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Variable Data Info.vi Returns information about a variable. Refer to the VI Help for more details.

 

Subpalette Description
Advanced VarMan VIs Advanced VarMan VIs.
Legacy VarMan VIs VIs to maintain compatibility for legacy applications. These VIs can still be used but have modern successors.
R/W Multiple Variables VIs to read and write multiple variables.
Variabe History VIs VIs to configure, read and write variable history.
